nameJa: パール・エディトリアル
conceptNote: 真珠色の余白、大きい黒の見出し、浅く彫刻した赤いチャット。動画の内側にチャットを置く関係を、上品な立体の図にまとめる。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished premium abstract promotional tile for the YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen browser extension, not a moodboard or contact sheet. Wide 11:7 canvas, target 1760x1120, edge-to-edge artwork.
Art direction: pearl-white editorial design. Warm pearl-white background, near-black precision typography, a single vivid YouTube-red accent. Restrained tactile finish and excellent contemporary graphic-design craft. The sophistication comes from composition, spacing, optical balance, and beautifully controlled surfaces, not effects.
Typography: left-aligned confident Swiss grotesk. Large readable headline occupying the left half with generous space. Exact visible copy, each phrase ONCE: "YouTube" (smaller eyebrow), "Fullscreen" (one single word, large), "Live Chat" (large). No other words, letters, taglines, numbers, labels, logos or watermark. Text must remain easy to read when the entire tile is reduced to 220x140.
Graphic: on the right, a precise front-facing 16:9 video frame with subtle pearl ceramic surface, clean dark edge, and a simple black play triangle toward its left. A beautiful sculpted red rectangular speech bubble with three neat white horizontal strokes sits FULLY INSIDE the video frame on its right. It is visibly a chat overlay inside fullscreen video, never an external sidebar. Give the bubble only shallow realistic thickness and a soft grounded contact shadow, not an inflated toy. Four fine fullscreen corner marks carefully bracket the video. No interface screenshots.
Composition: generous 7% safe area around all typography; graphic may be larger but fully inside the canvas. Balanced headline and symbol, calm large negative space, strictly horizontal and frontal. Keep the chat visually within the four fullscreen marks.
Avoid: people, faces, gaming scenes, landscapes, browsers, phones, dashboards, fake chat messages or usernames, random text, neon, glowing lines, lens flare, gradients, abstract blobs, confetti, exaggerated 3D, oversize shadows, tilt or perspective, generic AI art. This must look like an art-directed design studio's polished editorial campaign, with simple geometric meaning.

revisionHistory.reason: Initial native source was panoramic; recompose to compact11:7 without cropping or stretching.
revisionHistory.prompt:
Edge-to-edge landscape 11:7 composition (target 1760x1120), NOT a panoramic banner.
Use the attached image only as the design reference. Recompose this exact pearl-white editorial design into a taller, compact 11:7 Chrome Web Store promotional tile. Keep the sophisticated pearl surface, near-black Swiss typography, shallow sculpted red chat bubble, frontal black play triangle, and precise four fullscreen corners.
Preserve verbatim visible copy, each exactly once: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". Fullscreen must remain one word. No extra text.
Arrange the three lines of copy in a large left-aligned block in the upper-left, filling approximately the top 43% of the canvas. Place a large precise 16:9 video frame across the lower half, shifted slightly right. This horizontal video frame contains the play triangle at left and red speech bubble FULLY INSIDE it at right. The frame occupies roughly 70% of total tile width, with room around it; no clipping or overflow. Keep the icon relationship unmistakable: chat overlay inside fullscreen video, not an external chat sidebar.
Text is optically oversized and legible at 220x140. Maintain 7% safe margins for words. Restrained tactile depth and subtle contact shadow, clean art-directed spacing, warm pearl-white, black and vivid red only.
No people, scenes, fake chat messages, names, dashboard, screenshot, neon, glow, random decorative details, watermark. Preserve all text accuracy and material finish. Prioritize the requested compact 11:7 tile shape; do not return the wide2.5:1panorama from the reference.

headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
